workflows.tmpl_header: # mw platform workflow definition template (v2, with description/input/output fields)
workflows.tmpl_field_steps_order: - steps execute left-to-right in array order
workflows.tmpl_field_description: - description: brief summary of this step's main task, under 500 chars (recommended for every step to keep the process tidy and not miss key info)
workflows.tmpl_field_input: - input: input documents (optional), paths/docs this step references, e.g. upstream step outputs
workflows.tmpl_field_output: - output: output documents (optional), paths/docs this step is expected to emit, for downstream steps as input
workflows.tmpl_field_required_role_tags: - required_role_tags: capabilities the worker must have (matched against worker registry scope.tags)
workflows.tmpl_field_split_policy: - split_policy: controls the rule for switching worker between steps
workflows.tmpl_field_split_policy_prefer: - prefer_split: default to switching worker, same worker acceptable
workflows.tmpl_field_depends_on: - depends_on: upstream step_id to depend on (default = previous array entry)
workflows.tmpl_field_loops: - loops: list elements are step_ids, indicating failure-re-path (can point to multiple upstream steps)
workflows.tmpl_field_pass_threshold: - pass_threshold: how many successful passes count as done (empty = one-shot pass)
workflows.tmpl_field_optional: - optional: true = this step can be skipped by main/product-manager per task type (e.g. pure backend skips design); default false = mandatory
workflows.tmpl_field_skip_when: - skip_when: suggested skip-cases (hotfix/typo/doc_only etc.), advisory only, never auto-skipped
workflows.tmpl_your_task_body:
Please generate a workflow per the schema above, satisfying: [write your requirement here]
Reply format: pure YAML, outer wrap `workflows: { "your-id": {...} }`, do not wrap in ```.
workflows.tmpl_example_description: New feature development; on test failure route back to design/implementation, requires at least 3 successful passes to finish
workflows.tmpl_example_step_req_desc: Break down requirements, clarify scope and acceptance criteria
workflows.tmpl_example_step_arch_desc: Derive the technical plan from requirements, fix module boundaries and interfaces
workflows.tmpl_example_step_test_desc: Write and execute tests, covering acceptance criteria
workflows.tmpl_example_step_review_desc: Review code quality, security, and maintainability
